python - <<'PY'
import sys
import xarray as xr
import xarray.structure.concat as cmod

TARGET_FILE = cmod.__file__
TARGET_LINE = 642
captured = []

def tracer(frame, event, arg):
    if event == 'line' and frame.f_code.co_filename == TARGET_FILE and frame.f_lineno == TARGET_LINE:
        name = frame.f_locals.get('name')
        if name == 'temp':
            vi = frame.f_locals.get('variable_index')
            captured.append((name, vi.copy() if hasattr(vi, 'copy') else vi))
    return tracer

sys.settrace(tracer)

ds1 = xr.Dataset(
    data_vars={
        'a': ('x', [1, 2]),
        'temp': ('x', [10, 20]),
    },
    coords={'x': [0, 1]},
)
ds2 = xr.Dataset(
    data_vars={
        'a': ('x', [3, 4]),
    },
    coords={'x': [0, 1]},
)

out = xr.concat([ds1, ds2], dim='sample', data_vars='all', coords='minimal')
sys.settrace(None)
print('captured:', captured)
print('out sizes:', dict(out.sizes))
PY
